rules.description: Applicant must be at least 15 years and 9 months old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 15 years and 9 months old to apply for a provisional driving licence

rules.description: Applicant must have been given permission to live in Great Britain for at least 185 days
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been given permission to live in Great Britain for at least 185 days

rules.description: Service is for Great Britain residents only
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for Great Britain residents only. Northern Ireland residents should contact DVA.

rules.description: Applicant must not already hold a full driving licence
rules.reason_if_failed: You already hold a full driving licence. Use the renewal service if you need to update it.

rules.description: Applicant must be able to read a number plate from 20 metres away
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be able to read a number plate from 20 metres away. If you need glasses or contact lenses to do this, you can still drive.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a visual condition that may affect ability to read number plates
edge_cases.action: Route to manual assessment. DVLA may require an eyesight test certificate from an optician.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a medical condition that must be declared
edge_cases.action: Route to medical assessment. Specific conditions (epilepsy, diabetes, heart conditions) require DVLA medical review.

edge_cases.description: Complex immigration status requiring manual verification
edge_cases.action: Route to immigration status verification team. Additional documentation may be required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has been previously disqualified from driving
edge_cases.action: Check disqualification period has ended. Route to manual assessment if period active or special conditions apply.
